title_en: Minimum wage is a legal right
text_en: No employer may pay any employee less than the minimum rate of wages notified by the government. This applies to workers in organised and unorganised sectors.
Wages for daily work must be paid at the end of the shift. Weekly wages are due on the last working day before the weekly holiday. Monthly wages are due before the seventh day of the next month.

title_en: Claim unpaid wages within three years
text_en: A worker can apply to the authority for unpaid wages within three years from the date the claim arises. A later application can be accepted if there is sufficient cause.
Registration on e-Shram is free and workers pay no one for it. Registered workers get accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh under PMSBY.

Unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income up to Rs 15,000 can join PM-SYM. It gives an assured pension of Rs 3,000 a month at age 60. Joining is voluntary and contributory, and the government matches the contribution.

title_en: Domestic workers: no dedicated central law
text_en: There is no dedicated central law for domestic workers. They are covered only through the general labour codes and state policies.

source.name: Supreme Court order 29 Jan 2025 / expert committee report

text_en: 14434 is the e-Shram helpdesk (also 1800-8896811) with Hindi support. It helps with e-Shram registration and benefits. It is not a channel for wage claims.
